title: Rise Above application
description: Apply for Rise Above sober living with support from your case manager.
howTo: Open the form, complete the required questions, and submit it. Ask your case manager if you need help.
importantNotes: Confirm availability and eligibility with Rise Above before applying.

title: Find a certified recovery home
description: Browse current recovery homes in New Hampshire.
howTo: Choose a home, confirm openings and eligibility, then follow its application instructions.

title: Harbor Care recovery housing application
description: Start a recovery housing application.
howTo: The form asks for personal details. Complete it only on the provider’s secure page.

title: A Way Out admissions
description: Apply for men's sober living in Nashua.
howTo: Review the criteria, then follow the application link on the provider’s site.

title: kathy ireland Recovery Centers application
description: Application for their sober living program.
howTo: Review the specific home, fees and rules before you submit.

title: NH recovery housing guidance
description: Read state information on recovery housing.
howTo: Use this to learn about recovery housing and ask staff to help compare options.

title: NH EASY
description: Apply for or manage NH Medicaid, SNAP and other benefits.
howTo: Create or sign in to your account, select your benefit, and follow the document requests in your notices.

title: NH DHHS assistance guide
description: Learn what programs are available and how to apply.
howTo: Use this page if you are unsure which benefit to select in NH EASY.

title: AmeriHealth rides
description: Arrange a covered ride through the plan's transportation service.
howTo: Call CTS at least two business days before a routine ride. Have your plan ID and appointment details ready.

title: NH Healthy Families rides
description: Arrange a covered ride through the plan's transportation service.
howTo: Call MTM to arrange a covered ride. Check the plan page for current eligibility and timing.

title: WellSense rides
description: Arrange a covered ride through the plan's transportation service.
howTo: Request a routine ride at least two business days ahead. Have your plan ID and appointment details ready.

title: AmeriHealth Caritas NH
description: Find benefits, providers and member support.
howTo: Use the member pages to check your coverage.

title: NH Healthy Families
description: Find benefits, providers and member support.
howTo: Sign in or use the member pages for plan information.

title: WellSense NH Medicaid
description: Find benefits, providers and member support.
howTo: Check the NH Medicaid member page for plan details.

title: Replace a Social Security card
description: Start a free replacement card request.
howTo: Check whether you can apply online. If not, follow the appointment instructions.
importantNotes: There is no fee for a replacement card.

title: New Hampshire ID card
description: See how to apply for a non-driver ID.
howTo: Review identity and residency requirements before visiting DMV.

title: Birth certificate
description: Request a certified NH birth record.
howTo: Check who can request a copy and what ID or fees are required.
importantNotes: For births outside NH, contact that state or territory.

title: NH Works job seekers
description: Find jobs and employment support in NH.
howTo: Use Job Match or contact an NH Works office for help.

title: The Doorway
description: Find substance use treatment and recovery support in NH.
howTo: Choose a Doorway location or call 211 to connect with help.

title: New Hampshire AA meetings
description: Find AA meetings by town, day and format.
howTo: Search nearby meetings and confirm details before attending.

title: Granite State NA meetings
description: Find NA meetings in and around NH.
howTo: Filter the list by area or day and check location details.

title: NH Food Bank food finder
description: Find food assistance and mobile pantries.
howTo: Search local food resources or check the mobile pantry schedule.

title: 211 New Hampshire
description: Find food, housing, utility, legal and other local help.
howTo: Search by need and location, or call to speak with a resource specialist.

title: How to file a motion (checklist)
description: A New Hampshire court checklist for preparing a motion.
howTo: Read the checklist, then confirm the current filing steps with the court clerk.
importantNotes: Court forms and filing rules can change; ask the court which forms apply.

title: Motion form (NHJB-2201-DFP)
description: General court form for requesting an action in an existing case.
howTo: Enter the case information and your request. Confirm filing and service steps with the court.
importantNotes: Use only if this motion form fits your case; court staff can explain filing steps.

title: Motion to waive filing fee (NHJB-2759-SUP)
description: Ask the court to consider waiving a filing fee.
howTo: Complete the form and ask the court how to submit it with your filing.
importantNotes: The court decides whether a filing fee can be waived.

title: Motion to vacate default or recall warrant (NHJB-2978-D)
description: Court form to ask for review of a default and/or warrant.
howTo: Read the form and check with the court or your lawyer about filing it in your case.
importantNotes: Submitting a form does not itself change a court order or warrant.

title: Request for a lawyer (NHJB-4044-DSSUPe)
description: Request court-appointed counsel in a qualifying case.
howTo: Complete the requested information and ask the court how to submit the form.
importantNotes: Eligibility depends on the case and the court’s decision.

title: Court change of address (NHJB-2409-DFP)
description: Notify the court when your mailing address changes.
howTo: Enter your case and new address. Ask the clerk how to file the notice and notify other parties.
importantNotes: Keep your contact information current with the court.

title: Social Security card paper application (SS-5)
description: Print the form for an original or replacement Social Security card.
howTo: Print the PDF, complete and sign page 5 in black or blue ink, and bring it with the required original documents to your local Social Security office.
importantNotes: Applying for a Social Security card is free. Read pages 1–4 for document requirements.

title: Duplicate NH license or non-driver ID (DSMV637)
description: Request a replacement for a lost or damaged NH driver license or non-driver ID.
howTo: Use this only if replacing an existing card. Print and complete the form, then check DMV instructions for required ID and fees.
importantNotes: For a first-time ID, use the separate NH DMV resource above.

title: Assurance Wireless Lifeline
description: Check eligibility and apply for Lifeline phone service.
howTo: Enter your ZIP code, review eligibility, and start the application on the provider’s website.
importantNotes: Service availability and eligibility vary; apply on the provider’s site.

title: SafeLink Wireless Lifeline
description: Check eligibility and apply for SafeLink phone service.
howTo: Open the site, review Lifeline eligibility, and follow the application steps.
importantNotes: Lifeline is generally limited to one benefit per household; confirm current terms with the provider.

title: Paper SNAP and benefits application (BFA 800)
description: Paper NH DHHS application for SNAP and other assistance.
howTo: Print the form, complete the sections that apply, and follow its instructions to submit it to NH DHHS.
importantNotes: The form covers several programs. NH DHHS may require an interview and supporting documents.

title: The Process Recovery Center
description: Outpatient treatment and recovery support in Nashua.
howTo: Review the programs and call to ask about admissions and current availability.
importantNotes: Confirm program fit and coverage with admissions.
